## Project Status & Dates

**Project Status:** Real momentum this period — Ross confirmed readiness to begin building the Waabanong production environment (kickoff with Campfire planned for next week), and case file UAT formally launched with a full walkthrough that brought two new CRD testers (Rupen, Leanne) into the pool. The walkthrough also surfaced two concrete bugs (case-reference structure for child-in-care cases, and a director field incorrectly changing on supervisor reassignment) that need fixing before broader testing continues. The backlog of pending go-live deliverables (stress test, cutover sign-off, consolidated readiness update to Ross) hasn't shrunk yet, so schedule remains Red, but client engagement stayed strongly positive.

**Variance:** Planned finish 2026-03-31 → Estimated finish 2026-07-31 (+122 days)

## Progress This Period

- Case file/ongoing-services UAT walkthrough held (Jul 28) with two new CRD testers (Rupen, Leanne) — full walkthrough of case creation, case notes, placements, legal status, signs of safety, face-to-face visits/AMR plans, documents, and finance-tab stub.
- Ross confirmed readiness to begin building the Waabanong production environment, with a kickoff meeting planned with Campfire Help Desk next week.
